CC: Logout Process (iOS)

Quick Reference Guide

| This Quick Reference Guide (QRG) shows how to logout of the PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration (CC) Mobile Application on iOS. |
| :---: |

| Logout: To log out of the PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration application, select Logout from the main menu. The PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration application will display a confirmation window. Select Logout to proceed or exit the confirmation window to cancel. | ![][image1] ![][image2] |
